meta.description: Read comfortably in Arabic and English, with help on every difficult word.

home.greeting: What would you like to read?
home.emptyBody: Upload a PDF you already have, or pick something free from the open library.
home.dropHint: or drop a PDF anywhere on this page

library.title: Library
library.emptyBody: Books, papers and articles you add will appear here, with your progress.
library.removeBody: It leaves your library, along with your reading position. You can upload it again any time.
library.removeBodyNotes: It leaves your library, along with your reading position and {count, plural, one {# highlight, note or bookmark} other {# highlights, notes and bookmarks}}. This can't be undone.

explore.title: Explore
explore.subtitle: Free books and papers from open libraries, all public domain or openly licensed.
explore.shelvesUnavailable: The open libraries aren't responding right now. Try searching, or come back in a little while.
explore.error: Search didn't work. Please try again.
explore.noResults: Nothing found. Try other words, or another language or source.

importErrors.too-large: This file is larger than 50 MB, so it can't be opened here. Read it on its source's site.
importErrors.not-pdf: The source didn't send a PDF. Read it on its source's site.
importErrors.no-file: There's no file to open for this item.
importErrors.not-open: This item isn't openly licensed, so it can't be opened here.
importErrors.unavailable: The source isn't responding right now. Please try again in a moment.

explore.scannedNote: A scan of the printed book: it opens in Original mode.
explore.textOnlyNote: Opens in Reading mode, from Project Gutenberg's text edition.
explore.linkOutNote: This one is read on its source's site: its file can't be fetched for you here.
explore.notFoundBody: It may have been removed from its source, or the source isn't responding right now.
explore.fullTextNote: Opens in Reading mode, from Europe PMC's full text (figures and tables stay on its site).

hindawi.title: Hindawi Foundation
hindawi.body: Thousands of modern Arabic books, free to read on Safahat, the foundation's own site.

words.title: My Words
words.emptyBody: While reading, tap a marked word and choose “Save to my words”. It will appear here with the sentence you found it in.
words.exportCsvHint: For Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets
words.exportAnkiHint: Import in Anki with File → Import

auth.signInBody: Sign in to keep your library, notes and words in sync.
auth.checkEmail: Check your inbox — we sent you a sign-in link.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in isn’t configured yet. Add your Supabase keys to .env.local.

upload.dropTitle: Drop to add to your library
upload.panelDone: {count, plural, one {# file added} other {# files added}}
upload.scannedNote: Scanned pages: Reading mode and Smart Assist will need OCR (coming later). Original mode works.

errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB.
errors.corrupt: This PDF looks damaged and can't be opened.
errors.network: Connection lost. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reader.noContents: This document has no table of contents.
reader.textError: The text of this document couldn't be loaded.
reader.preparingText: Preparing Reading mode… This takes a few seconds for long books.
reader.focusOn: Focus mode on. Move the mouse or tap to show the controls; press F to leave.
reader.readingNeedsText: This PDF is scanned images with no text, so only Original mode is available.
reader.garbledNote: The text in this PDF may come out jumbled.
reader.missingBody: It may have been removed, or the link belongs to someone else’s library.
reader.assistPaused: Smart Assist paused until tomorrow — reading still works.
reader.assistLimit: Today's Smart Assist allowance is used up — reading still works.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Your highlights, notes and bookmarks in this document.
notes.empty: Select any text to highlight it or add a note. Everything you mark appears here.
notes.emptyBookmarks: Press B or the bookmark button to bookmark a page.
notes.saveFailed: That change couldn't be saved. Please try again.

search.label: Search in this document
search.noText: This document is scanned images, so there's no text to search.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Work anywhere in the reader except while typing.

assist.title: Smart Assist
assist.description: Marks hard words and the people, places and ideas in the text. Hover or tap one to see what it means.

status.unavailable: Smart Assist isn't set up on this server yet (no GEMINI_API_KEY).
status.noText: This document is scanned images, so there's no text for Smart Assist to read.
status.paused: Smart Assist has used today's free quota. It's paused until tomorrow; reading still works.
status.limit: You've used today's Smart Assist allowance. It resets tomorrow.

assist.thisDocument: Use Smart Assist for this document
assist.thisDocumentHint: When off, its text is never sent to the AI.
assist.levelPromptBody: Smart Assist only marks words above your level. You can change this any time.
assist.turnedOff: Smart Assist off. Press A to turn it back on.
assist.saveFailed: That word couldn't be saved. Please try again.

notFound.person: We couldn't find a reliable match for this person on Wikipedia, so we won't guess who they are.
notFound.place: We couldn't find a reliable match for this place on Wikipedia.
notFound.org: We couldn't find a reliable match for this organisation on Wikipedia.
notFound.event: We couldn't find a reliable match for this event on Wikipedia.

assist.demoNote: Demo mode: these explanations are placeholders. Add GEMINI_API_KEY to .env.local for real ones.

problem.paused: Smart Assist is paused until tomorrow (today's free quota is used up). Reading still works.
problem.limit: You've used today's Smart Assist allowance. It resets tomorrow.
problem.unavailable: Smart Assist isn't set up yet.
problem.off: Smart Assist is off for this document.
problem.busy: Wikipedia is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
problem.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
problem.aiBusy: The AI is very busy right now. Try again in a moment.

review.title: Review
review.doneBody: {count, plural, one {You reviewed # word.} other {You reviewed # words.}} Each comes back just before you'd forget it.
review.nothingDueBody: Words come back for review just before you'd forget them. You can still practise now.
review.noWordsBody: While reading, tap a marked word and choose “Save to my words”.

speech.title: Pronunciation
speech.sampleEn: Reading opens the door to new worlds.
speech.sampleAr: القراءة تفتح الأبواب إلى عوالم جديدة.
speech.hint: Want a more natural voice? Add one to your device, then choose it here. On a Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Read & Speak → System voice → Manage Voices, and pick an "Enhanced" or "Premium" voice. On Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech. Your choice is kept on this device.
speech.unsupported: This browser can't read text aloud.
speech.engineDeviceHint: Free and instant, using the voices on this device.
speech.engineAiHint: More natural, by Gemini, in English and Arabic. It takes a few seconds to start and uses the shared daily AI allowance; when that runs out, the device voice reads instead.
speech.aiUnavailable: The AI voice isn't set up on this server (it needs a Gemini API key), so the device voice is used.
speech.deviceVoices: Device voices (used when the AI voice isn't available)

fallback.limit: You've used today's AI allowance, so your device voice is reading instead.
fallback.paused: The AI voice is paused until tomorrow (the daily limit was reached), so your device voice is reading instead.
fallback.aiBusy: The AI voice is busy right now, so your device voice is reading instead.
fallback.unavailable: The AI voice isn't available, so your device voice is reading instead.
fallback.error: The AI voice didn't respond, so your device voice is reading instead.
